purpose: Fresh evidence audit for four Upper Colorado section routes added while expanding Colorado toward 50 public routes.

sourcePolicy.access: Current BLM recreation-site pages are the controlling endpoint-access evidence. Rancho Del Rio is explicitly treated as private fee access.
sourcePolicy.gauge: Direct same-river USGS telemetry is retained for the Upper Colorado corridor: 09058000 for the Pumphouse/Radium block and 09060799 for the State Bridge/Catamount block.
sourcePolicy.flow: Flow cues are conservative planning gates carried from existing route evidence; they are not presented as runnable guarantees.
sourcePolicy.camping: Only designated BLM or explicitly private fee camping is described; day-use and no-camping endpoints are stated where applicable.
sourcePolicy.imagery: Each route has a dedicated current BLM Recreation.gov image record and route-gallery entry.
sourcePolicy.deduplication: Short sections are retained as separate named access-to-access options while the existing macro reaches remain published; each record states its downstream take-out boundary.

routes.camping: Designated endpoint camping at Pumphouse and Radium; reservation/fee compliance required
routes.highClassHandling: Eye of the Needle and high-flow holes above approximately 4,000 cfs are called out; same-day scouting and rescue readiness required

routes.takeOut: Rancho Del Rio private fee river access
routes.camping: Designated BLM Radium camping; Rancho Del Rio private fee campground subject to operator terms
routes.highClassHandling: Red Eye and Class III Yarmony named; private access, PFD, cold-water, and mandatory Rancho take-out controls

routes.flowGate: 700-9,000 cfs bounds; 1,200-7,000 cfs preferred planning band
routes.camping: Day use only at both endpoints; Two Bridges explicitly prohibits camping
routes.highClassHandling: Moving-water, cold-water, bridge, wood, sediment-covered-ramp, and mandatory Two Bridges take-out controls

routes.flowGate: 700-9,000 cfs bounds; 1,200-7,000 cfs preferred planning band
routes.camping: Two Bridges day use only; designated Catamount campsites with seasonal stay limits
routes.highClassHandling: Moving-water, cold-water, seasonal parking, and mandatory Catamount take-out before harder downstream water

validation.routeOverlapAudit: Existing corridor-overlap findings are expected for section/macro pairs and are documented as consolidation review, not duplicate endpoint pairs.
validation.geometryAudit: Existing combined 40 MiB asset-budget failure remains infrastructure-only; route data audits pass.
